Mark 3b: its menu, the plans selector's own menu re-lettered "Schedules": "149" (picked, its ●), "249 · Exercise North" (149's detachment, his own example, D2088), "142". Only the schedules he may see are listed; someone who may see one sees no ▾, as today. Picking one changes the schedule pages — Edit Schedule, View-only Sched, the Scheduler Board — and Logic; Inputs, Quals, the Leave War and the Tracker stay on his own squadron's people.

As ruled (one "Close detachment", D2103), seen by 149's admin, with what pressing it should ask, drawn in (mark 7): the app's own question card hanging from the button, as your lesson 77 asks — "Close Exercise North? Its schedules stay, read only, under Past detachments. Its 6 people are back on 149's schedule from today, and their overseas duty ends today." The last clause is my reading, not yet ruled: closing early cuts their overseas duty inputs short. Keep open is the safe answer, as on the app's other cards. The button keeps "Close detachment" on one line (round 2's drawing broke it in two).
